mapper.select: select id, registration_no, season_id, team_id, captain_member_id, captain_player_id, contact_name, contact_mobile, contact_email, registration_status, lineup_count, submitted_time, audit_time, withdrawal_time, withdrawal_reason, current_auditor_id, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_tournament_registration where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_tournament_registration where season_id = #{seasonId} and registration_status = 3 and is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_tournament_registration where season_id = #{seasonId} and is_delete = 0 and registration_status in (1, 2)
select count(1) from basket_tournament_registration r inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where s.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} and r.is_delete = 0

select id, registration_no, season_id, team_id, captain_member_id, captain_player_id, contact_name, contact_mobile, contact_email, registration_status, lineup_count, submitted_time, audit_time, withdrawal_time, withdrawal_reason, current_auditor_id, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_tournament_registration where season_id = #{seasonId} and team_id = #{teamId} and registration_status = 3 and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select r.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName from basket_tournament_registration r inner join basket_team t on r.team_id = t.id and t.is_delete = 0 and t.audit_status = 1 where r.season_id = #{seasonId} and r.registration_status = 3 and r.is_delete = 0 order by t.team_name

select r.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, lf.access_url as logoUrl from basket_tournament_registration r inner join basket_team t on r.team_id = t.id and t.is_delete = 0 and t.audit_status = 1 left join basket_file_asset lf on lf.id = t.logo_file_id and lf.is_delete = 0 where r.season_id = #{seasonId} and r.registration_status = 3 and r.is_delete = 0 order by t.team_name

select r.id from basket_tournament_registration r where r.is_delete = 0 and r.registration_status = 3 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_team_season_profile p where p.registration_id = r.id and p.is_delete = 0 ) order by r.audit_time asc, r.id asc

select distinct r.id as registrationId, r.registration_no as registrationNo, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.platform_code as platformCode, r.submitted_time as submittedTime, tm.tournament_name as tournamentName, s.season_name as seasonName, coalesce(nullif(trim(s.season_name), ''), tm.tournament_name) as eventName, t.team_name as teamName from basket_tournament_registration r left join basket_team t on t.id = r.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament tm on tm.id = s.tournament_id and tm.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and ( r.captain_member_id = #{memberId} or exists ( select 1 from basket_tournament_registration_player rp where rp.registration_id = r.id and rp.member_id = #{memberId} and rp.is_delete = 0 ) ) order by r.submitted_time desc, r.create_time desc limit 50
mapper.update: update basket_tournament_registration set registration_status = #{toStatus}, current_auditor_id = #{currentAuditorId}, remark = #{remark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and registration_status in #{s} and (current_auditor_id is null or current_auditor_id = #{auditorId})
